name: BuildVoyage

sources.title: Submission desk — 'Free 48h review, manual curation. No account needed — we email you one link to confirm.' Multi-step form: product info, tech stack (min 2 technologies), review

requirements: Micro-SaaS / product fit — the site is 'a curated directory of micro-SaaS' with manual curation and 48h review
Product Name, Tagline (10-80 chars), Description (min 50 chars, supports bold/italic/headings/lists), Website, your email
Category pick from their list (AI, dev tools, productivity, marketing, etc.)
Tech stack: minimum 2 technologies requested (frameworks, languages, databases, infra, APIs, payments, AI/ML) — though the form also notes listings can go live without them
Confirmation via a single email link — no account or password needed
Rights/agreement checkbox: 'I have the right to share this content' + Terms/Privacy
preparation: Tagline (10-80 chars) and a ≥50-char formatted description
At least two real technologies the product runs on
Square logo (256px+) and screenshots — uploaded AFTER confirming the email link, not in the form itself
An email inbox you control — the confirmation link completes the submission
workflow: Step 1: fill product name, tagline, description, website, email, category, optional pricing
Step 2: add at least two tech-stack entries
Step 3: review and submit, agreeing to terms
Click the confirmation link in the email — it takes you straight to the listing to upload logo/screenshots
Listing goes through manual review (~48h) then appears in the directory and rotates through homepage spotlight
watchFor: Do NOT skip the email confirmation — the submission isn't complete until the link is clicked; that's also when media gets attached
The form's tech-stack requirement text is contradictory (required/min-2 vs 'can add later') — fill two entries to be safe
A 'security check blocked' notice may appear under aggressive privacy extensions — submission still works but whitelisting helps
Optional checkbox subscribes you to a weekly roundup email — uncheck if unwanted
Sponsored banner slots and a /sponsor page exist — advertising is separate from the free listing
countsAsLive: The product page is publicly listed in the BuildVoyage directory (/products) and can rotate through the homepage spotlight
unknowns: Whether listings carry dofollow or nofollow links
Rejection rate of the manual 48h review
Whether the tech-stack requirement is enforced server-side
